name: Newquay
blurb: Our home town. Drop-offs from Pentire, Porth, Lusty Glaze, Trenance, Tretherras and the town centre.

name: St Columb Major
blurb: A short drive inland along the A39 corridor, ideal for hems and zips on the way into town.

name: St Mawgan & Mawgan Porth
blurb: Close to RAF St Mawgan, where Sylvia spent her career as a military tailor.

name: Crantock
blurb: Just across the Gannel. Popular for jeans hems and curtain shortening for holiday lets.

name: St Newlyn East
blurb: A few miles south of Newquay, an easy hop for repairs and alterations.

name: Quintrell Downs
blurb: On the doorstep. Bring trousers, jeans and coats with broken zips.

name: Perranporth
blurb: Wetsuit-and-jeans country. Zip replacement and seam repairs are our everyday work.

name: St Austell
blurb: Worth the drive in from mid Cornwall for jeans hems, zips and curtain shortening.

name: Truro
blurb: Cornwall's city. Customers bring trousers, coats and curtains to us for alterations and repairs.

name: Padstow & Wadebridge
blurb: Up the coast. Holiday-let curtains and cushion zips are a speciality worth the trip.

name: Indian Queens & St Dennis
blurb: A quick run down the A30 for everyday alterations and mending.

name: Holywell Bay & Cubert
blurb: Small jobs welcome, from a single button to a full set of trouser hems.
